title: Copast
content:
et-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' -Name fDenyTSConnections -Value 0
Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup "Remote Desktop"
Restart-Service TermService -Force
netstat -an | findstr 3389
